feed.title: Mosthofa Imran: Errata and Retractions
feed.subtitle: Corrections to RFC 0001 and its position papers

entry.title: 7.1 Paper 5.3 downgraded from 0.80 to 0.60
entry.summary: Two readers demonstrated the effect reproduces in private mailing lists with no ranking algorithm present, which breaks the proposed mechanism. Section 3 of "Algorithmic Homophily" is being rewritten and currently says so at the top. Reported by A. Rahman and K. Osei.

entry.title: 7.2 Paper 5.10 retracted in full: "Vector Databases Are a Fad"
entry.summary: The central claim failed. Retrieval quality at scale turned out to depend on index properties the author had dismissed, and the operational story matured faster than predicted. What the paper was actually right about was narrower and less quotable. Original text preserved, struck through, with the retraction attached at the head.

entry.title: 7.3 Principle 4.3 violated in production
entry.summary: The June 2025 ingest incident traced to a retry path with backoff and no budget, in code the author reviewed and approved. Ninety-four minutes of degraded intake. Postmortem published unredacted, including the review comment where the question was not asked.

entry.title: 7.4 Figure 3 of the ClickHouse note had a mislabelled axis
entry.summary: Milliseconds, not seconds. The conclusion was unaffected but the chart flattered the result by a factor of a thousand, which is exactly the kind of error that should be published rather than quietly swapped. Reported by S. Datta.
